project.title: Flow: A Red Blood Cell's Adventure
project.description: 'Flow' is a collaborative passion project with my friend that we made for our highschool Biology class. It features the journey of a red blood cell as it navigates through the human body.

project.title: Cadmium Blue
project.description: 'Cadmium Blue' is a personal project of mine that I wish to turn into a comic one day. In this story I aim to highlight and convey the feeing of grief that comes with losing someone you love.

project.title: Website Portfolio
project.description: My goal is to create my own interactive website that features all the artwork and designs I've made all throughout my creative journey.
